title: codex reviewer pane dies instantly: `codex exec` rejects `--ask-for-approval`, no `<review>` ever emitted
description: CAM-54 live-validation ceremony (2026-07-22, reviewer=codex/gpt-5.3-codex, mixed run over CAM-396) found the codex reviewer path is broken end-to-end. CodexAdapter.renderActor (src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts) builds `codex exec <sandboxArgs> -m <model> -c model_instructions_file=<f> <prompt>`, where codexSandboxArgs (backend-adapter.ts:367) returns '--sandbox workspace-write --ask-for-approval never'. But `codex exec` (codex-cli 0.144.6) does NOT accept `--ask-for-approval` -- it is a TOP-LEVEL codex flag, not an `exec` subcommand flag. Valid `codex exec` flags are -s/--sandbox, -c/--config, -m/--model, --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox, -C/--cd, --output-schema, --json, -o/--output-last-message. Reproduced deterministically: `codex exec --sandbox workspace-write --ask-for-approval never -m gpt-5.3-codex -c model_instructions_file=/tmp/x 'prompt'` => "error: unexpected argument '--ask-for-approval' found". So codex exits at argv parse BEFORE any work, the reviewer pane dies before emitting a <review> verdict, and after 3 identical BLOCKED outcomes the supervisor circuit-breaks (cam-worker-events.jsonl: sidecar-exit reason=circuit-broken consecutiveCount=3). Evidence the codex dispatch itself resolved correctly: spawn-resolution events show phase=reviewer model=gpt-5.3-codex backend=codex (no silent claude fallback). FIX: codexSandboxArgs must not pass --ask-for-approval on `codex exec`; set the non-interactive approval policy via `-c approval_policy=never` (config override, which exec DOES accept) or rely on exec's non-interactive default, keeping `--sandbox workspace-write`. This means the CodexAdapter was never actually exercised against a real `codex exec` (CAM-350 tests asserted argv SHAPE, not that codex accepts it) -- add a live/contract test that runs `codex exec --help`-validated flags or a real smoke. Blocks CAM-54 closure and CAM-330/331. Type fix.

spec.scope: In src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts the codexSandboxArgs helper's non-bypass branch (line ~367) renders '--sandbox workspace-write --ask-for-approval never', but `codex exec` (codex-cli 0.144.6) rejects --ask-for-approval at argv-parse (it is a TOP-LEVEL codex flag, not an exec-subcommand flag), so any codex-backed worker/reviewer pane exits before doing work and the supervisor circuit-breaks after 3 identical BLOCKED outcomes. Fix codexSandboxArgs so the non-bypass branch sets the non-interactive approval policy via the config-override form '-c approval_policy=never' (which `codex exec` accepts, verified live), keeping '--sandbox workspace-write'; leave the bypass branch ('--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox') unchanged. Update the helper's header doc comment (lines ~348-361) which currently documents the wrong '--ask-for-approval never' rendering (doc-maintenance, same edit). Flip the shape assertions in test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts (lines ~54-63) that asserted the buggy '--ask-for-approval never' shape (these are the shape-only assertions that let the bug ship), and add a contract test that asserts the rendered CodexAdapter `codex exec` argv for every worker actor uses only flags on codex exec's accepted flag surface, in particular never '--ask-for-approval', so re-introducing an exec-rejected flag fails a test. Do NOT invoke real `codex` in the suite: CI (macos-latest) has no codex binary or auth. Scope is limited to src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts and test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: codexSandboxArgs for a non-bypass permissionMode renders a string containing '--sandbox workspace-write' AND '-c approval_policy=never' AND NOT containing '--ask-for-approval'. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts]

codexSandboxArgs for permissionMode 'bypassPermissions' still renders '--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox' and contains neither '--sandbox' nor '--ask-for-approval' nor 'approval_policy'. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts]

A contract test enumerates codex exec's accepted flag surface and asserts the rendered CodexAdapter argv for every worker actor uses only accepted flags, in particular never '--ask-for-approval'; the test fails if an exec-rejected flag is re-introduced. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts]

The header doc comment on codexSandboxArgs in src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts describes the '-c approval_policy=never' rendering and no longer claims a '--ask-for-approval never' rendering. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
The full quality spine is green after the change. [oracle: bun run check:all]
gotchas: src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts:367 codexSandboxArgs returns '--sandbox workspace-write --ask-for-approval never' for the non-bypass branch; change the '--ask-for-approval never' fragment to '-c approval_policy=never', keeping '--sandbox workspace-write'. Verified live on codex-cli 0.144.6: `codex exec --sandbox workspace-write -c approval_policy=never ...` parses cleanly (session header prints 'approval: never / sandbox: workspace-write'), whereas '--ask-for-approval never' yields clap 'error: unexpected argument --ask-for-approval found'.

src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts:348-361 the header doc comment for codexSandboxArgs describes the '--sandbox workspace-write --ask-for-approval never' rendering and asserts --sandbox/--ask-for-approval are mutually exclusive with --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox; rewrite it to describe the '-c approval_policy=never' rendering. This is doc-maintenance in the same edit, not a separate change.

test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts:54-63 currently asserts toContain('--ask-for-approval never') for the non-bypass branch; this is the shape-only assertion that let the bug ship. Flip it to assert toContain('-c approval_policy=never') and not.toContain('--ask-for-approval'). Line 50 already asserts not.toContain('--ask-for-approval') for the bypass branch; keep it.

codex exec accepted flags (codex-cli 0.144.6, from `codex exec --help`): -s/--sandbox {read-only|workspace-write|danger-full-access}, -c/--config key=value, -m/--model, --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox, -C/--cd, -p/--profile, -i/--image, --output-schema, --json, -o/--output-last-message, --color, --ephemeral, --oss. There is NO --ask-for-approval on the exec subcommand (it is a top-level codex flag). approval_policy is a valid config key overridable via -c.

Do NOT add a live `codex exec` invocation to the test suite: CI (macos-latest) has no codex binary and no codex auth, so the contract test must assert the rendered argv STRING against the documented accepted-flag surface, not shell out to codex. Independent operator note (not this issue's scope): with the current ChatGPT-account codex auth every explicit model returns HTTP 400 'not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account', so a live codex smoke would also fail for an unrelated account reason.
src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts is sidecar-executed code: after this ships, a coherence rebuild is required (bash scripts/build-release.sh --install, then restart the sidecar by exact pid).
domainTerms: CodexAdapter: the codex-CLI implementation of BackendAdapter that renders `codex exec` argv for the four worker actors (ADR-0047).
codexSandboxArgs: helper in backend-adapter.ts mapping permissionMode to codex's sandbox/approval flags.
approval_policy: codex config key (set via -c approval_policy=never) selecting the non-interactive approval behavior on `codex exec`.
